'''Alexandro''' is a male NPC who appears in [[Bank Street]], [[Ragunna]], near Trattoria Margherita. He can be seen arguing with [[Riccardo|Riccardo de Fisalia]].

''(To Be Added)

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Riccardo de Fisalia:''' I heard that Montelli's golds flow on every river in today's Ragunna.
:'''Alexandro Montelli:''' Simple rule of supply and demand. The market calls and we're only answering their needs.
:'''Riccardo de Fisalia:''' And I was wondering why Ragunna City reeks of money and snobs these days.
:'''Alexandro Montelli:''' Some folks are eager to work with us in their pursuit of wealth and self-actualization. We're simply providing them with the platform.
:'''Alexandro Montelli:''' Since we're on that matter, do you have financial needs we can assist you with? I couldn't help but notice the lofts in Fisalia Residencies seem... out of repair.
:'''Alexandro Montelli:''' If you're planning on a renovation, rest assured—I have some connections in construction and design.
:'''Riccardo de Fisalia:''' Hmph—I would not waste my breath lecturing you on defending the longstanding traditions and principles of Ragunna, and of Rinascita.
:'''Riccardo de Fisalia:''' We Fisalias would never disrespect our values and beliefs. But you Montellis wouldn't wait to walk away from these for your grand "course", would you?
:{{DIcon}} (It got pretty intense...)
:{{DIcon}} (Best not to interrupt...)
:'''Alexandro Montelli:''' We're simply adapting to the times. Even the Order is willing to guide us toward ascension. Only fools would drown in old dreams.
:'''Alexandro Montelli:''' Oh, forgive me—I nearly forgot.
:'''Alexandro Montelli:''' In the past, it was you who controlled the Order and the path of ascension. But now...
:'''Riccardo de Fisalia:''' Mind you, though we may have past our prime, our family still stands stronger than yours.
:'''Alexandro Montelli:''' There, you said it yourself, Fisalia is history now.
{{Dialogue End}}
